data.name: ViveTool_PageDescription
data.value: Shandisa zvikamu zveWindows uchishandisa ViVeTool. Shandisa kana kudzivirira zvikamu zveWindows zvakanaka/zvinobatsirwa.

data.name: ViveTool_WarningMessage
data.value: Zvinhu zvinokanganisa: kusvandudza zvikamu zveWindows kunogona kuparadzira Windows Update, madhatsi, driver, uye kutarisana kwechimwe chinhu. Endesa point yekuchengetedza pamberi. Shandisa zvakanaka chete izvi Zvinhu zveChiyero (Feature IDs). Kuchinja kwakawanda kunoda ku-reboot uye kungakanganiki kuti kudzivirira pasina backup.
